technique: Textbook PINN: MLP on the ten raw contract inputs plus a put flag; PDE residual in spot coordinates on the training box; soft payoff loss; Adam
Exact symmetry reduction: forward log-moneyness z, weight share s, tau and (sigma_1, sigma_2, rho); driftless PDE; put-call parity; far boundary at Levy values
Hard terminal condition: c = Levy + tau * N(z, s, sqrt(tau), sigma, rho), so the payoff holds exactly and the network learns the correction
Loss balancing: residual weighted by tau / tau_max against the 1/sqrt(tau) blow-up at the strike, with collocation tau = tau_max u^2
Residual-based adaptive sampling (RAD): every 1000 steps keep 32,768 of 131,072 candidates drawn with probability proportional to |residual| / mean + 1
Boundary-layer coordinate: the network also sees tanh(d / 3) with d = z / (Levy total volatility), the variable in which the near-expiry correction to Levy settles
Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS (strong Wolfe line search) warm-started from P5 on 16,384 RAD-selected collocation points
Second-order refinement: Nystrom-preconditioned Newton-CG (Rathore et al., 2024; from the 1D study) warm-started from P6
Scale up: width 128 and 25,000 Adam steps from a fresh start, then 1,000 L-BFGS iterations and 20 Newton-CG steps
Enveloped correction: c = Levy + tau * phi(d_2) * N, which fades like the time value away from the strike; trained from a fresh start through the Adam, L-BFGS and Newton-CG stages
Anchored (hybrid) PINN, as in the 1D study: fine-tune P9 with the PDE residual plus reference prices at 4,096 anchor contracts of the training domain (their own seed), then L-BFGS
Textbook DeepONet: branch on the seven raw contract parameters plus a put flag, trunk on (S_1/K, S_2/K, tau); price labels from the reference; Adam
Exact symmetry reduction: branch on (sigma_1, sigma_2, rho), trunk on (z, s, tau); put-call parity
Hard terminal condition: c = Levy + tau * <branch, trunk(z, s, sqrt(tau))>
Differential (Sobolev) training: add the nine derivative labels in (y_1, y_2, tau, sigma_1, sigma_2, rho), first and second order in the log forwards
Physics-informed DeepONet: add the PDE residual on unlabelled collocation over the whole computational domain (tau from 0) and the far-boundary condition
Boundary-layer coordinate in the trunk: tanh(z / (3 sigma_ref sqrt(tau))) with sigma_ref = 0.35, so the trunk still sees coordinates only
Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS warm-started from D5 on 4,096 labelled contracts and 4,096 collocation points
Scale up: width and rank 128 and 131,072 labelled contracts from a fresh start, then the L-BFGS stage of D6
Enveloped correction: c = Levy + tau * phi(d_2) * <branch, trunk>, trained from a fresh start through the Adam and L-BFGS stages
Ensemble: average of four independently seeded D8 trainings (seeds 0-3); Greeks are member averages
